Specifications

FOUNDATION

Earth quake resistant R.C.C. pile foundation

STRUCTURE

R.C.C. framed structure.

WALLS

Made of good quality concrete hollow blocks

WALL FINISH

External walls: Cement /weather coat paint finish.
Internal walls: Putty finish with emulsion or equivalent painth.

DOORS

Designed hardwood front door.
Doors inside: Moulded panel doors for interiors

WINDOWS

Anodized aluminium windows with steel grills and glass panes

FLOORING

Entrance lobby - good quality granite/vitrified tiles. Upper floor lobbies-vitrified tiles. Interior-good quality vitrified tiles.

KITCHEN

Functionally designed kitchen with granite work - top and stainless steel sink with drain board. Glazed tiles above working platform to a height of 60 cm.

TOILETS

Ceramic tile-flooring. Ceramic tile dadoing upto 7 ft. Concealed plumbing with PVC pipes, coloured sanitary fixtures (Cera or equivalent) and chromium plated taps & shower fittings (Marc or equivalent). Master bed toilet with geyser provision.

ELECTRICAL WORK

Single Phase power supply with concealed conduit copper wiring with independent energy meter controlled by ELCB & MCB. light and fan points and other necessary plug points with modular switches ( Crabtree or equivalent).

WATER SUPPLY

Drinking water from KWA line in kitchen sink. Water drawn from well for other purposes. Round the clock water supply through sump and overhead tanks

TELEPHONE & T.V. LINE

Telephone and T.V. line provision in drawing room & master bedroom.

CAR PARKING

Swimming pool, health club, round the clock security, modern fire fighting system, party area, children's play area, intercom facility to security room, generator backup for common area lighting and lifts, 2 Lifts: one with 10 persons capacity and a bed lift.

*All alterations at extra cost
